sections.title: PawSharp.Interactions
sections.content:
PawSharp.Interactions

Verifies Discord interaction webhook signatures (X-Signature-Ed25519 / X-Signature-Timestamp headers) per the Discord HTTP Interactions spec. Discord signs each HTTP interaction request using Ed25519. The message that is signed is the concatenation of the raw timestamp header value and the raw request body bytes. A request is valid only when: 1. The X-Signature-Timestamp is not older than 5 minutes (replay protection). 2. The Ed25519 signature covers timestamp_bytes || body_bytes and verifies against the application's Ed25519 public key shown in the Developer Portal. Usage: var verifier = new WebhookVerifier("your_application_public_key_hex"); bool valid = verifier.Verify(signatureHeader, timestampHeader, requestBodyBytes); if (!valid) { return Results.Unauthorized(); } The Ed25519 verification is implemented using arithmetic for full portability across platforms without adding NuGet dependencies. For high-throughput scenarios consider replacing the inner method with a native binding (e.g. NSec.Cryptography).

sections.content:
PawSharp.Interactions.Extensions.InteractionExtensions

Methods

GetOptionValue``1(InteractionCreateEvent interaction, string name)

Gets the value of a named slash command option, cast to . Supports string, int, long, double, bool, and ulong. Automatically walks into the first-level subcommand options when the interaction uses a subcommand. Returns default if the option is not found or the cast fails.

ParameterDescription
interactionThe interaction event.
nameOption name, case-insensitive.

GetSubcommandName()

Returns the name of the invoked subcommand (type 1), drilling through a subcommand group (type 2) when present, or null if no subcommand was used.

GetOptionValue``1()

Gets the value of a named option from an explicit option list, cast to . Useful for subcommand options.

FindOption()

Finds a named option (top-level only).
